title: Dropping some requests early saves the rest
body: When demand exceeds capacity, accepting everything degrades all requests into timeouts; shedding load at the edge, rejecting cheap and early, preserves success for the admitted fraction. Google's SRE literature treats overload as a queuing problem with a triage answer. A system that fails partially and fast looks, from the user's chair, indistinguishable from health for most people most of the time.
